title: Polymorphic Build
statement: Implement `solve(calls)`. `calls` is a list of class names, each `user` or `admin`. A classmethod on the base uses `cls` to construct. Return the list of constructed class names in order, lowercase. Calling the inherited method on Admin must append `admin`.
constraints: Admin does not override the constructor method
hints: Look up the class for each name and call the classmethod.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: cls is the class the method was looked up on, not the class that defined the method.

editorial: cls is the class the method was looked up on, not the class that defined the method. A loop of calls is the demonstration that each call binds its own cls. Hardcoding the base name would return user for every entry.
